name: Soul Lantern
description: A patient ember of your soul waits faithfully at your side. Your Soul Lantern follows your path, finding room around you and settling when you rest.

conditions.command: execute if entity @s[nbt={OnGround:1b}] unless block ~ ~ ~ #mrt_supports:lantern_idle_forbidden unless data entity @s RootVehicle

execute if score @s SW.LanternRest matches 0 if entity @s[nbt={OnGround:1b}] unless block ~ ~ ~ #mrt_supports:lantern_idle_forbidden unless data entity @s RootVehicle unless entity @s[nbt={HurtTime:10s}]

actions.command: execute store result score $LanternOrbitTarget SW.LanternTargetAngle run data get entity @s Rotation[0] 100
execute as %t run scoreboard players operation @s SW.LanternTargetAngle = $LanternOrbitTarget SW.LanternTargetAngle
execute store result score %t SW.LanternPoseHeight run apoli:resource get %a mrt_supports:soulweaver/lantern/animations_pose-height
execute as %t at %a rotated as %a rotated ~ 0 run function mrt_supports:soulweaver/lantern/select-follow-position
execute as %t at %a rotated as %a rotated ~ 0 run function mrt_supports:soulweaver/lantern/place-follow-position
execute store result score %t SW.LanternDelta run data get entity %a Motion[0] 1000
execute store result score %t SW.LanternDesiredVel run data get entity %a Motion[1] 1000
execute store result score %t SW.LanternVelDiff run data get entity %a Motion[2] 1000
execute store result score $LanternOrbitTarget SW.LanternTargetAngle run data get entity @s Rotation[0] 100
execute as %t run scoreboard players operation @s SW.LanternTargetAngle = $LanternOrbitTarget SW.LanternTargetAngle
execute store result score %t SW.LanternPoseHeight run apoli:resource get %a mrt_supports:soulweaver/lantern/animations_pose-height
execute as %t at %a rotated as %a rotated ~ 0 run function mrt_supports:soulweaver/lantern/select-follow-position
execute as %t at %a rotated as %a rotated ~ 0 run function mrt_supports:soulweaver/lantern/validate-orbit-step

action.command: execute store result score @s SW.LanternDelta run data get entity @s Pos[1] 1000

actions.command: execute store result score %t SW.LanternVelDiff run data get entity %a Motion[1] 1000
execute as %t at %a rotated as %a rotated ~ 0 run function mrt_supports:soulweaver/lantern/position-at-orbit
execute store result score $LanternYaw SW.LanternTargetAngle run data get entity @s Rotation[0] 100
execute as %t run scoreboard players operation @s SW.LanternTargetAngle = $LanternYaw SW.LanternTargetAngle
execute store result score %t SW.LanternStrand run apoli:resource get %a mrt_supports:soulweaver/lantern-strands_state
